name: fromSingleMk_surjective
statement: ℤ} (α : Cocycle ((singleFunctor C p).obj X) K n) (q : ℤ) (h : p + n = q) (q' : ℤ) (hq' : q + 1 = q') : ∃ (f : X ⟶ K.X q) (hf : f ≫ K.d q q' = 0), fromSingleMk f h q' hq' hf = α

name: toSingleMk_surjective
statement: ℤ} (α : Cocycle K ((singleFunctor C q).obj X) n) (p : ℤ) (h : p + n = q) (p' : ℤ) (hp' : p' + 1 = p) : ∃ (f : K.X p ⟶ X) (hf : K.d p' p ≫ f = 0), toSingleMk f h p' hp' hf = α
